maps.setup_needed: Set an origin and destination in the device settings.
maps.refresh_needed: Press Refresh route to calculate the saved route.
maps.image_missing: Google Maps did not return a route line for the image.
maps.image_unavailable: No image is available. Enable route images and refresh the saved route.

pair.title: Set up your Maps route
pair.intro: Choose your origin, destination, travel mode and route image preference. Select an address suggestion or Use typed address to use a full address or latitude, longitude directly.
pair.requirements: Address suggestions need Places API (New) enabled and allowed for your Maps API key in app settings. Searches run only while you type and may incur Google charges. Use typed address remains available if suggestions cannot be loaded.
pair.image_help: Requires Maps Static API and route images enabled in app settings. Images are fetched only on demand after a device or Flow refresh; there is no automatic polling.
pair.no_results: No Google suggestions available. Try a more complete address or select Use typed address.
pair.search_error: Address search failed. Check Places API (New) and your Maps key, or continue with a manually entered address.
pair.traffic_help: On by default for driving route images. Traffic colors must also be enabled in the app settings. Applies on the next refresh and uses Google Routes Enterprise billing.
pair.homey_location_help: If selected, Homey's current coordinates are sent to Google when you refresh the route.

maps.route_unavailable: No route results are available. Refresh the saved route first.
maps.invalid_minutes: Enter a non-negative number of minutes.

address.typed_help: Use typed address or coordinates. Google Maps resolves the location when calculating the route.
address.search_unavailable: Use typed address or coordinates. Google suggestions unavailable: __error__

maps.settings_busy: Route settings are already being changed. Try again.

repair.title: Edit your Maps route
repair.intro: Edit the addresses, travel mode, and image options for this device. Choose a suggestion or enter a full address or latitude, longitude. Older locations saved as IDs are looked up when you open this screen. Refresh the route on the device or from a Flow to see new results.
repair.address_lookup_failed: A previously saved location could not be looked up. Enter or select its address before saving.

maps.homey_location_unavailable: Homey's location is unavailable. Check Homey's location settings or use an address instead.
maps.use_readable_address: Enter an address or coordinates instead of a place ID, or use Repair to choose an address.
maps.invalid_deadline: Enter an unambiguous date and time in Homey's time zone (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm, 24-hour clock), or leave it blank.
maps.invalid_buffer: Enter a whole number between 0 and 1440 minutes.

speech.title: Configure speech voice
speech.language_default: Use the default voice for this language
speech.translation_help: Pick a preferred voice for each language you announce in. Languages without a preference use a matching Cloud voice. If this option is off, announcements use basic Google TTS.
speech.no_voices: No Cloud voices are available. Check the Cloud Text-to-Speech configuration in the app settings.
speech.choose_language: Choose an announcement language to preview.
speech.speaker_help: Used by speech and translation actions. An explicit speaker on an announcement card overrides this choice. All speakers includes every discovered target; only compatible Sonos rooms can be synchronized.
speech.release_notice:
Google Services has major new features:
- Announce text on Google Cast, Sonos and compatible UPnP/DLNA speakers, including all speakers or your own speaker groups. Previous playback and volume are restored afterwards.
- Google Maps: travel times and routes with traffic.
- Choose and preview Cloud voices per device.

See the wiki for the user manual and the Google Services topic on the Community Forum for help.
speech.speaker_all_no_tvs_help: Skip recognized TVs and video Cast receivers
speech.speaker_all_no_tv_speakers: All speakers (no TVs or TV speakers)
speech.speaker_all_no_tv_speakers_help: Also skip recognized soundbars and home theater speakers

settings.groups_intro: Create named groups of announcement speakers to use in Flows or as a device default.
settings.group_members_help: Select the speakers in this group. Offline members are skipped during announcements.
settings.group_no_speakers: No speakers found. Turn on your speakers and refresh the list.
settings.groups_starting: The app is still starting. Try opening the Groups tab again in a moment.
settings.group_delete_confirm: Delete "__name__"? Flows and device defaults that use it will need a new selection.
settings.group_volume_help: The adjustment and maximum apply only when the Flow sets a speaker volume.
settings.sonos_save_error: Could not save the Sonos mode.
settings.sonos_load_error: Could not load the Sonos mode.
settings.group_ip_help: Reserve fixed IP addresses for your Sonos speakers in your router. With Play Separately, Homey can reuse known addresses instead of scanning the network, so announcements can start faster.
settings.check_help: Tests use saved settings and make a sample request to Google. Quota or charges may apply.
settings.check_result_missing: Enter and save the required credentials and settings first.
settings.check_result_busy: This test is already running. Try again shortly.
settings.check_result_billing: Google reported a billing problem. Check billing in Google Cloud Console.
settings.check_result_disabled: Google reported that the API is disabled. Enable it in Google Cloud Console.
settings.check_result_credentials: Google credentials are invalid or could not be loaded. Check and save them again.
settings.check_result_quota: Google reported a quota or rate limit. Check usage and quotas in Google Cloud Console.
settings.check_result_access: Google denied access. Check API enablement, billing, and key restrictions or service account permissions.
settings.check_result_unreachable: Google did not respond in time or is unavailable. Try again later.
settings.check_result_failed: The test failed. Check the saved settings and try again.
